newsitem.title: UK: British Airways slips on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: British Airways slips on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc slipped on Tuesday as investors continued to take profits after the stock reached a record last week, dealers said.
At 0756 GMT, the shares were off 2p to 685-1/2, putting them among only 17 FTSE 100 stocks to post losses.
The blue chip index soared into uncharted territory after the Dow jumped two percent to new peaks.
London dealers attributed profit-taking to an overhang of stock and uncertainty about how the newly elected Labour government would treat the UK air carrier. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
